mode: reference-guided generation and a targeted portrait edit

steps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square RPG vehicle portrait.
Create a small late-1970s Japanese step-through 50cc commuter moped of the type sold in the United States, with a Super Cub-like silhouette. The reference image supplies ONLY the existing illustration style and quiet roadside setting, NOT its heavy motorcycle design.
The moped has a slender faded turquoise pressed-steel frame, scuffed ivory leg shield, narrow spoked wheels with slim black road tyres, short simple fork, small round headlight, modest straight handlebar with two small mirrors, a tiny air-cooled engine, ONE short separate black saddle and a faded rust-red plastic milk crate securely strapped to the flat rear rack behind the saddle. The crate is empty and open at the top. No passenger pad. Compact, lightweight utilitarian machine; readable thin wheels, modest body width; no cruiser tank, no V-twin engine, no broad scooter floorboard.
Elevated front-left three-quarter view, front toward lower left; entire moped, both wheels, mirrors, rear crate fit comfortably inside the square. Stationary unoccupied on a quiet cracked asphalt shoulder, sparse dry weeds and gravel. Side stand down, engine off. Detailed realistic hand-painted post-apocalyptic tabletop artwork, fine material texture, restrained rust, chipped paint, dusty chrome. Muted neutral daylight and natural colors, same finish as the reference. Mechanically intact. No rider, people, weapons, text, logos, letters, numbers, insignia or watermark. Opaque background.

references.role: painting style and roadside setting only

steps.prompt: Precise object edit. Keep this moped portrait exactly as it is: same composition, vehicle, color, materials, lighting and road.
